electric_boiler.note: Elektrokotel je fyzicky odpojený od elektřiny. Stav tlačítka termostatu se čte automaticky z EMOS DP2.

energy_pricing.tempering_price_basis: current 2026 D45d low-tariff variable price incl. VAT from official ČEZ price list; fixed monthly charges excluded because they are paid regardless of tempering

historical_invoice_average_variable_pric.note: Historical average from the latest annual invoice; retained for audit only, not used as the current tempering price.

current_variable_price_czk_per_kwh_vat.includes: energy supply + distribution + electricity tax + system services, VAT included; quantity-independent monthly charges excluded

hdo_boiler_blocking.tariff_requirement: D45d requires technical blocking of electric heating during high tariff
hdo_boiler_blocking.pricing_assumption: Use NT price for the intended HDO-controlled boiler operation; retain VT price as a fallback sensitivity until the actual wiring is verified.
